source._version_note: v3.7.3 is the LATEST Loki GA (queue-latest-version policy, owner 2026-06-25). go.mod directive is `go 1.26.4`; golang:1.26-bookworm ships go1.26.4 EXACTLY (== go.mod), so GOTOOLCHAIN=local compiles with ZERO toolchain download — matches the --network=none offline promise. There is NO go.work in the tree (confirmed `ls go.work*` => none) so GOWORK=off is NOT needed. Offline drive: `go mod vendor` then build `-mod=vendor`. RISK: if Docker Hub later reverts golang:1.26-bookworm to a patch < 1.26.4, GOTOOLCHAIN=local would FAIL — pin GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.4 (or the builder digest) in the offline kit. LIVE-VERIFIED on <redacted: internal host>: clean `go build -tags netgo -trimpath`, `loki, version 3.7.3 (branch: HEAD, revision: 82cdcdc0)`, go version go1.26.4, platform linux/amd64, tags netgo, 147M (153,989,282 bytes) static ELF, exit 0.
source._no_vendor_build_note: Loki is API-only with ZERO go:embed of frontend assets — a plain `go build ./cmd/loki` yields a complete server. NO Node/npm/asset-gen step (unlike prometheus/grafana/syncthing). source.vendor_build is intentionally OMITTED (null).

binaries_from_source._note: Single static binary; main_pkg ./cmd/loki (cmd/loki/main.go). Default -target=all IS the single-binary monolithic mode (all components in one process) — it is the upstream default, passed explicitly in the entrypoint for clarity. Version package github.com/grafana/loki/v3/pkg/util/build (vars Version/Branch/Revision); its init() copies them into github.com/prometheus/common/version which `loki -version` prints. Stamp the BARE version `3.7.3` (no leading v). Mirrors upstream Makefile `make loki`. verify_subcmd is `-version` (single dash, Go flag), NOT --version.
